app.title: Fund Manager
field.name: Name
login.title: Sign in
login.defaultHint: First run: sign in with admin / admin. You will be asked to change it.
login.twoFactorHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from Google Authenticator.
login.mustChangeHelp: You are using the default account. Choose a new password (you can also change the username) before continuing.
account.title: Account
account.passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
purchases.listHint: Click to select · double-click to edit
purchases.newRowHint: Double-click here to add a purchase
purchases.summaryPlaceholder: Purchase summary, e.g. Groceries at E-Mart
purchases.costHint: Sum of price × quantity of all items in this purchase
purchases.carryReadOnly: Carried-over records are created automatically when the previous month is confirmed.
purchases.confirmMessage:
Money left of {amount} will be carried over to {next} as a record dated {date}.
An existing carried-over record will be overwritten.
The month is locked until you reopen it.
purchases.cascadedToast: Carried-over amounts were also refreshed for: {months}.
purchases.reopenMessage: The month becomes editable again. The amount carried over to {next} stays as it is until you confirm this month again.
purchases.bannerConfirmed: Confirmed on {date}. Money left ({amount}) was carried over to {next}. Reopen the month to make changes.
purchases.bannerStale: The amount carried over to {next} no longer matches this month. Confirm again to update it.
purchases.bannerPrevUnconfirmed: {prev} is not confirmed yet, so its money left ({amount}) has not been carried over.
purchases.bannerMismatch: The carried-over amount ({carry}) differs from the money left in {prev} ({amount}). Confirm {prev} again to update it.
items.selectPrompt: Select a purchase on the left to manage its items.
items.selectHint: Double-click the empty row on the left to create a new purchase.
items.editHint: Double-click a row to edit it. Changes are stored when you press Save.
items.lockedHint: This month is confirmed. Items are read-only.
items.newRowHint: Double-click here to add an item
items.willCreateStandard: "{standard}" is a new standard for {name}. It will be added when you save.
items.chooseStandard: {name} has several standards. Choose one, or type a new one.
items.willCreate: "{name}" is not registered. It will be added to products when you save.
items.matchesList: Matches the cost in the purchase list.
items.invalidCount: Quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.
items.unsavedMessage: The item list of the selected purchase has unsaved changes.
funds.intro: Fund inputs are money added during a month. Carried-over records are created automatically when a month is confirmed.
funds.empty: No fund records in this year.
funds.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
funds.deleteMessage: Delete the fund input of {amount} on {date}?
products.title: Products
products.intro: Products are suggested while you type in a purchase. New names typed there are added here automatically.
products.name: Name
products.standardHint: Size, volume, weight or model, e.g. 1L, 500g, size M. The same name can exist once per standard. Leave empty if there is none.
products.activeHint: Inactive products are kept for history but are not suggested any more.
categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Organize products in nested categories. Select a category to edit it or add a subcategory.
categories.name: Name
categories.sortHint: Lower numbers are listed first; equal numbers are sorted by name.
categories.productCountHint: Products in this category and its subcategories
categories.selectPrompt: Select a category on the left, or add a new one.
categories.deleteWithProducts: Delete the category "{name}"? Its {count} products will become uncategorized.
categories.deleteWithProducts_one: Delete the category "{name}"? Its 1 product will become uncategorized.
report.title: Monthly Report
report.noComparison: No spending last month to compare
report.flowSubtitle: What you spent each day and the money left at the end of each day. Hover or use the arrow keys for details.
report.byCategorySubtitle: Top-level categories with their subcategories, as a share of all spending.
report.topProductsSubtitle: Where most of the money went (× quantity bought).
report.allProductsSubtitle: Each product and standard: how often, how many and at what prices. Click a column to sort.
report.journalSubtitle: Every record of the month by date: what you bought and what came in. Click a purchase to open it.
settings.title: Settings
settings.general.languageHint: Texts come from the dictionary. You can change any wording in the Dictionary tab.
settings.general.currencyHint: Used for display and input precision.
settings.data.hint: All data is stored locally in this SQLite file.
security.title: Two-step verification (Google Authenticator)
security.intro: Optional. When enabled, signing in also requires a 6-digit code from the Google Authenticator app.
security.step1: Install Google Authenticator (or another TOTP app) on your phone.
security.step2: Scan the QR code, or enter the key manually.
security.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app to finish.
security.recoveryHelp: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once to sign in if you lose your phone.
security.regenerateHelp: Old recovery codes stop working. Enter your password to continue.
security.disableHelp: Enter your password to turn off two-step verification.
users.title: Users
users.intro: All users share the same data. New users must change their temporary password at first sign-in.
users.tempPasswordHint: At least 6 characters. The user must change it at next sign-in.
dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.intro: Edit the text shown for any item. Changes are saved as soon as you leave a field; clear a field (or press ×) to restore the default. Built-in texts live in src/i18n/en.json and ko.json.
error.auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
error.auth.codeAlreadyUsed: This code was already used. Wait for the next code.
error.auth.secondFactorExpired: The sign-in timed out. Please sign in again.
error.auth.samePassword: Choose a password different from the current one.
error.auth.passwordEqualsUsername: The password must not be the same as the username.
error.user.weakPassword: The password must be at least {min} characters.
error.user.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
error.category.duplicateName: A category with this name already exists at this level.
error.category.cycle: A category cannot be moved under itself or one of its subcategories.
error.category.hasChildren: This category has {count} subcategories. Move or delete them first.
error.category.hasChildren_one: This category has a subcategory. Move or delete it first.
error.product.duplicateName: A product with this name and standard already exists.
error.product.inUse: This product is used in {count} purchase items and cannot be deleted. Mark it inactive instead.
error.product.inUse_one: This product is used in a purchase item and cannot be deleted. Mark it inactive instead.
error.item.invalidPrice: Row {row}: the unit price is not valid.
error.item.invalidCount: Row {row}: the quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.
error.item.notInPurchase: Row {row} does not belong to this purchase. Reload and try again.
error.item.tooMany: A purchase can have at most {max} items.
error.ledger.monthLocked: {month} is confirmed. Reopen it to make changes.
error.ledger.futureMonth: {month} has not started yet, so it cannot be confirmed.
